texts: The dark swallows will return to their nests on your balcony, and again playing with their wings on your glass they will call.
The dark swallows will return to your balcony, to their nests to hang, and again with the wing to their windows playing they will call.
The dark swallows will return to your balcony to hang their nests, and again they will play their wings on your windows calling.
The dark swallows will return to your balcony their nests to hang and again with the wing to their windows playing will call.
